name: Phone calls
note: Agent calls you, you call it
summary: Voice agents answer or place calls through a telephony provider. One route is Twilio ConversationRelay, where Twilio handles speech-to-text and text-to-speech and streams text to the agent over a WebSocket. Another is SIP: a trunking provider forwards calls to a speech-to-speech model such as the OpenAI Realtime API, which the backend accepts through a webhook.
facts: Official provider APIs (Twilio Voice, SIP trunking)
TwiML <Connect> to a wss:// server; Twilio does STT and TTS
Trunk to sip.api.openai.com, accept via webhook
goodFor: Agents that call users back with results
watchOut: Latency and interruptions need careful handling
Per-minute telephony plus speech and model costs
Carriers may block or flag automated calls
